targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  src_endpoint.ip as source_ip,
  'Port Scanning' as threat_type,
  toString(count(DISTINCT dst_endpoint.port)) as unique_ports,
  toString(groupArray(DISTINCT dst_endpoint.port)) as ports_scanned,
  'Network' as source_table
FROM network_activity
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND dst_endpoint.port IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip
HAVING count(DISTINCT dst_endpoint.port) > 10
UNION ALL
SELECT
  src_endpoint.ip as source_ip,
  'Brute Force SSH' as threat_type,
  toString(count(*)) as unique_ports,
  toString(groupArray(DISTINCT dst_endpoint.port)) as ports_scanned,
  'SSH' as source_table
FROM ssh_activity
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND severity IN ('Medium', 'High')
GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip
HAVING count(*) > 10
UNION ALL
SELECT
  src_endpoint.ip as source_ip,
  'HTTP Enumeration' as threat_type,
  toString(count(DISTINCT http_request.url.hostname)) as unique_ports,
  toString(groupArray(DISTINCT http_request.url.hostname)) as ports_scanned,
  'HTTP' as source_table
FROM http_activity
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  AND http_request.url.hostname IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip
HAVING count(DISTINCT http_request.url.hostname) > 5
ORDER BY unique_ports DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT time, metric, count
FROM (
  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(time) as time,
    'Failed Auth Attempts' as metric,
    count(*) as count
  FROM ssh_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND severity IN ('Medium', 'High')
  GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(time) as time,
    'Connection Failures' as metric,
    count(*) as count
  FROM network_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND status IN ('Failure', 'Reset', 'Refuse')
  GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(time) as time,
    'RDP Connections' as metric,
    count(*) as count
  FROM rdp_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  GROUP BY time
)
ORDER BY time ASC, metric ASC

SELECT
  dst_endpoint.ip as target_ip,
  'Multi-Protocol Targeting' as attack_pattern,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_table = 'Network' THEN 'Network' END) as network_events,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_table = 'SSH' THEN 'SSH' END) as ssh_events,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_table = 'HTTP' THEN 'HTTP' END) as http_events,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN source_table = 'RDP' THEN 'RDP' END) as rdp_events,
  total_events
FROM (
  SELECT dst_endpoint.ip, 'Network' as source_table, 1 as total_events FROM network_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dst_endpoint.ip, 'SSH' as source_table, 1 as total_events FROM ssh_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dst_endpoint.ip, 'HTTP' as source_table, 1 as total_events FROM http_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dst_endpoint.ip, 'RDP' as source_table, 1 as total_events FROM rdp_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
) attack_data
WHERE dst_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dst_endpoint.ip, total_events
HAVING (network_events > 0 AND ssh_events > 0) OR (network_events > 0 AND http_events > 0) OR (network_events > 0 AND rdp_events > 0)
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  'Port Scanning' as threat_category,
  count(*) as attacker_count,
  'Network Activity' as detection_method,
  '>10 unique ports per IP' as threshold
FROM (
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip
  FROM network_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
    AND dst_endpoint.port IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip
  HAVING count(DISTINCT dst_endpoint.port) > 10
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'SSH Brute Force' as threat_category,
  count(*) as attacker_count,
  'SSH Activity' as detection_method,
  '>10 high severity attempts' as threshold
FROM (
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip
  FROM ssh_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
    AND severity IN ('Medium', 'High')
  GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip
  HAVING count(*) > 10
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'HTTP Enumeration' as threat_category,
  count(*) as attacker_count,
  'HTTP Activity' as detection_method,
  '>5 unique hostnames' as threshold
FROM (
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip
  FROM http_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
    AND http_request.url.hostname IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip
  HAVING count(DISTINCT http_request.url.hostname) > 5
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'RDP Targeting' as threat_category,
  count(*) as attacker_count,
  'RDP Activity' as detection_method,
  '>3 connection attempts' as threshold
FROM (
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip
  FROM rdp_activity
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip
  HAVING count(*) > 3
)
ORDER BY attacker_count DESC

SELECT
  src_endpoint.ip as attacker_ip,
  dst_endpoint.ip as victim_ip,
  'Lateral Movement Attempt' as attack_stage,
  groupArray(DISTINCT protocol) as protocols_used,
  count(*) as total_events,
  time
FROM (
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip, 'SSH' as protocol, time FROM ssh_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  UNION ALL
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip, 'RDP' as protocol, time FROM rdp_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  UNION ALL
  SELECT src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip, 'SMB' as protocol, time FROM smb_activity WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
) lateral_movement
WHERE src_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL AND dst_endpoint.ip IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip, time
HAVING count(DISTINCT protocol) > 1
ORDER BY total_events DESC, time DESC
LIMIT 15
